description: Returns live Icelandic road surface conditions, closures, weight restrictions, and regional advisories from IRCA / Vegagerðin (umferdin.is/graphql with gagnaveita.vegagerdin.is REST fallback), ranked with hazards first (max 20).

limit.description: Maximum road segments to return (1-20, default 20).

route_or_region.description: Optional route number, pass, town, or region (e.g. '1', 'Route 41', 'Ring Road', 'Hellisheiði', 'South', 'Reykjanes', 'Westfjords', 'Highlands').

name: get_road_conditions
title: Get Road Conditions & Advisories (Vegagerðin / Umferðin)
